name: JW Marriott Quito
insider_take: Perched at 9,350 feet above sea level, this is one of the world's highest luxury hotels, offering breathtaking Andean mountain views and proximity to the equatorial line.
whats_special: The JW Marriott Quito sits in the heart of Ecuador's capital, just 15 minutes from Quito's UNESCO World Heritage historic center - one of the best-preserved colonial districts in Latin America. The hotel's location in the modern Gonzalez Suarez district provides stunning views of the Pichincha volcano and easy access to the Middle of the World Monument, where you can literally stand on the equator.
pro_tip: Take advantage of the hotel's high altitude location - the clear mountain air offers incredible stargazing opportunities from the upper floors, especially during Quito's dry season from June to September.
dont_miss: Visit the nearby TelefériQo cable car system that takes you up Pichincha volcano for panoramic city views, explore the vibrant La Ronda street in Old Town for authentic Ecuadorian crafts and cuisine, and take a day trip to the famous Otavalo indigenous market, just 90 minutes away.
pros: Prime location in Quito's financial district with easy access to attractions
Luxury JW Marriott service standards and amenities
Modern facilities with sophisticated business and leisure accommodations
Strategic base for exploring Ecuador's capital and cultural sites
cons: High altitude location may require acclimatization for some guests
Premium luxury pricing reflects upscale positioning
